items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The funny part about it was, years later, I got to play in this place myself, and guess who I hired?

ctx.x: Prentice. So I’d be banging on this piano. Oh, I’d go nuts. My mother loved it. So she said, “Play, boy, play.” She’d be sitting on a chair. I’m just playing. Then finally I started playing the saxophone. He used to call up and say, “Please. Piano, maybe.” “But,” he said, “saxophone.” He said, “I can’t stand it. Stop.” The funny part about it was, years later, I got to play in this place myself, and guess who I hired?
